Father, that was close.

The Ralads were so kind that
we found it hard to get back
to our journey.
1:
But though some time has passed,
we are on our way again.

Next we head for the City of the Rats.
I wonder what sort of place it is.
I hope it's like Raladin…

It seems I meet people whenever
I pass out. I hope this is a good meeting…

29: Well, we must be on our way…

51: I broke the plate. Not Tira.

70: (It can't be helped. We'll just have to trust Jasmine's hunch.)
71: (No, you don't understand. Both cards say "Death".)
73:
Father, what do I do?
Whichever card we draw,
we'll be put to death…
75: What became of your spirit? Draw a card. The cards of fate. One "Life", one "Death".
83: It's all right. Check the card left inside, and you'll know which one I drew.
84: It's the "Death" card. So what I drew must have been…
86: We've escaped death, somehow. Lief's luck is something else.
87: I could have drawn "Life" too, you know.
88: No, you couldn't. Both cards said "Death".

92: This won't be the end of it.
95: I hate to say it, but you should be.
99: How rude! Filli is not a rat!

107: But why do they fear rats so much? They're dirty, it's true, but…
109: Yes, and not a rat either. I know, I know. Let's go.

115: Ugh, the filthy smell of those Grey Guards…
117: And entering this holy kitchen, dressed like that!

123: When so many people are going hungry!
124: We only obey the holy law.

140: They must not have trusted the palace cooks.
142: The great one who rules the world, and his servants.
143: The ones who deceived the king.

150: Here you are. The rat has not been found…

155:
Father, it was as I thought.
The Ra-Kacharz send food out through
the Disposal Pit to the Grey Guards.
Red robes let you pass through.
156:
Those without red robes must
spend their whole lives here…
The thought hurts my heart.
157: Shouldn't we go back to Noradz?

160: True, but we've defeated the deceivers.
161: Right. The rest is for them to decide.
162: More to the point, they won't be making food there any more.
163: And that will stir up the palace in Del.
164: Will they realise it was us…

168: We have to cross this river!?
172: Lief, is there anything to eat? Something sweet would pick me up…
175: Ah! Don't mind if I do. You two can…
177: {fff8}Water Eaters{fffc}? You want me to eat these!?
179: Water Eaters? Do they eat water?
181: …Let's open it. Maybe they'll eat the river.
182: Good grief, now you too, Lief…
183: They're not creatures… More like see-through sand.
184: Whatever! Just put them in the river!
187: Hurry! It says the effect won't last long!
190: I don't think we have time for that.
193: I know you're tired, but let's press on.

205: What were the kings doing? All that time the Shadow Lord was spreading evil?
206: Well… The kings were being deceived…

208: Believe it or not, it's the truth.
209: Then the royal family really was fooled for over 100 years. And we're on this quest to help the heir of such fools?
212: Barda, it's all right. I understand how Jasmine feels.
213: But you know, Jasmine, I still want to give the Belt to the king's heir. Not for the royal family's sake. But to free the people and the land from the Shadow Lord. For everyone's freedom.
217: For now. But I may complain again.

231: The gems! Touch the gems on the Belt!
232: (Thank you, Barda.) (The topaz has cleared my mind.)
233: Say, this is strange. Why doesn't this snake attack?

But when evil draws near,
its red fades.
236: And it has the power to ward off evil!
